notes_for_editor: Only one short NHLR entry describes this tower. No build date, builder, design, staffing or access terms turned up in two searches or in the Arkansas lists read (Encyclopedia of Arkansas, Forest Lookouts). Do not merge it with the Iron Springs Recreation Area in Garland County, which is a CCC-built picnic area (1933) and a different place.
